title: testjig: upload route + blob sha256 for jmap:cid
description: testjig now advertises urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid (JMAP-01ba.5) but has no upload route (uploadUrl advertised, unrouted) and no blob store. draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 L144-148: sha256 MUST be present in every successful upload response; L222-224: server MUST NOT return null sha256 for a file FileNode created while the capability is active. MemoryBackend::blob_sha256 returns None for unseeded blobs, so jig-created File nodes get no sha256. Either add an upload route that stores bytes and seeds the digest, or decide the jig is exempt.
